title: Quaint Snappy Canadian Prawns Skewers
description: A nutty and snappy Canadian dish featuring raw king prawns, this recipe is a nostalgic treat that is also FODMAP-friendly. The air-fry method ensures a crispy exterior and a tender interior.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together almond flour, grated coconut, paprika, garlic-free seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the king prawns to the dish and toss to coat evenly with the almond flour mixture.
Thread the coated prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
Brush the prawns with lemon juice and olive oil.
Place the skewers in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between each skewer.
Cook the prawns in the air fryer for 8 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Serve the quaint snappy Canadian prawns skewers hot and enjoy.
